blocks.heading: Analytics & Dashboards for *Real Business Clarity*
blocks.lead: Custom dashboards that pull data from all your tools into one clear, real-time view — so you always know exactly how every part of your business is performing, without hunting through reports.

header.title: Dashboards for *every part of your business*
header.subtitle: From sales to marketing to operations — one source of truth for every decision.

items.title: Sales Dashboards
items.body: Pipeline health, revenue vs target, deal velocity, rep performance, and forecasting — all updated in real time from your CRM.

items.title: Marketing Analytics
items.body: Ad spend, CAC, ROAS, traffic attribution, and channel performance across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and organic — in one view.

items.title: Operations Dashboards
items.body: Inventory levels, fulfillment rates, team productivity, SLA adherence, and operational KPIs tracked and visualised automatically.

items.title: Executive Reports
items.body: Auto-generated PDF or email summaries sent to leadership weekly — the right numbers, no noise, zero manual effort.

items.title: Customer Analytics
items.body: Cohort analysis, lifetime value modelling, churn prediction, and NPS tracking to understand what keeps customers and what loses them.

items.title: Custom Visualisations
items.body: Bespoke charts, interactive drill-downs, and tailored KPI layouts designed to match how your specific team thinks and works.

header.title: From messy data to *clear insights*
header.subtitle: We handle everything — data auditing, pipeline building, dashboard design, and team training.

items.title: Data Audit
items.body: We inventory all your data sources, assess quality, and identify which KPIs actually matter — cutting through the noise before building anything.

items.title: Dashboard Design
items.body: UX-first layout design focused on how your team will actually use the data — not just technically correct, but genuinely useful.

items.title: Data Pipeline Build
items.body: We build ETL processes to pull, clean, and consolidate data from all your sources into a single, reliable warehouse or reporting layer.

items.title: Deploy & Train
items.body: Dashboards launched and connected. Full team walkthrough so everyone knows how to read, filter, and act on the data immediately.

items.title: Business Automation
items.body: Auto-populate your dashboards with fresh data

items.title: Digital Marketing
items.body: Track every marketing metric in one place

blocks.heading: Stop guessing. Start *knowing.*
blocks.body: Book a free data strategy call. We'll map out your ideal dashboard setup and show you what's possible in 10 days.
